performance.verdict: Campaigns fully dark 45+ days; GBP collapse confirms organic also failing.

findings.text: Meta and Google spend = $0 across all 28 days and all 45 series days; zero leads generated. Campaigns appear fully paused — not a tracking gap.
Extension with Marwan overdue since 2026-08-31; engagement is month-to-month lapsed. No contract gates next 3 months of paid activity.
SMS automation and Zoho Voice access both overdue since 2026-08-31; intake infrastructure incomplete, blocking contact-rate improvement Marwan requires.
GBP actions dropped -100% in last 7 days (0 vs prior-period baseline of ~7–13/day); calls and web clicks ceased — listing issue or suspension probable.
Search clicks fell -31.63% week-over-week and hit 0 on 2026-09-07/08; combined with GBP collapse, organic visibility is deteriorating across all touchpoints.

suggestions.text: Audit and reinstate GBP listing immediately; 28-day actions total 136 confirms the profile was functional before collapse.
suggestions.monday_update: GBP actions dropped to 0 for 9 consecutive days (last reading 2026-09-01) after averaging ~7–13/day earlier in the window — a listing suspension or verification lapse is the probable cause. Nacer to audit GBP dashboard for suspension notice and submit reinstatement or re-verification by 2026-09-11. Success check: GBP actions return to ≥5/day within 7 days of reinstatement (confirm by 2026-09-16).

suggestions.text: Hold all paid reactivation until Marwan extension is signed; $0 spend for 45 days makes relaunch a contract decision, not a buyer call.
suggestions.monday_update: Meta and Google have run $0 spend since at least 2026-08-12 (full 45-day series), generating 0 leads against a July average of 3 leads/day. No paid action is appropriate until the extension with Marwan is signed, as the engagement has lapsed. Sohib to confirm contract status by 2026-09-12; if signed, flag for immediate campaign reactivation review. Re-check paid readiness on 2026-09-12.

suggestions.text: Escalate SMS automation and Zoho Voice access to Nacer; both are overdue blockers gating intake before any lead volume can be recovered.
suggestions.monday_update: SMS automation and Zoho Voice access were both due 2026-08-31 and remain incomplete; these directly gate contact-rate improvement, which Marwan identified as the primary bottleneck after July's 3 leads/day was hit. Nacer to chase Andrew and Joy for Zoho Voice access credentials and confirm SMS workflow live status by 2026-09-11. Success check: both items marked live in Monday by 2026-09-12.
